name: Nepal Open 2016

venue.name: [SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Kavre](http://www.sosnepal.org.np/where-we-help/kavre/sos-hermann-geminer-school-kavre)
venue.details: On the second floor of the school building

information: Nepal Open 2016 is open to citizens of all countries, but only Nepali participants can win prizes and titles. The venue is located in SOS Children's Village Kavre, opposite to Kathmandu University and about 26km from the central region of Capital Kathmandu. Seat Limit is 80, register fast, registration fee is NRs 250 ($2.5) for 3x3 then for all other events it's NRs 60,($0.6). As the first official speedcubing competition in Nepal, here it comes!
